name: Organizing Your Problem Areas
equipment: The specific space or system that keeps getting messy
instructions: Identify the one area (physical or digital) that reliably becomes chaotic again shortly after you clean it up.
Ask why it recurs -- usually it is missing a "home" for things, not a lack of effort to tidy it.
Build a simple system (a specific folder, a designated spot) so maintaining it takes seconds, not a full reset each time.
Watch today's video for a deeper approach to organizing recurring problem areas.
